summary: Tested the new 'ui_language fully independent of country' feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: all 8 pytest cases pass, including the critical DE-country/EN-language and NL-country/PL-language recommendation+career-detail splits, PL regression, and language/country mutual independence via PATCH endpoints. Manually verified real AI output: DE/en user got German job titles ('Buchhalter/in', 'Kreditorenbuchhalter/in', 'Controller/in' ...) with fully English why/summary text - exact match to spec. Frontend: country-select screen's new language picker works correctly and is fully independent of country choice; Profile screen's new 'Jezyk aplikacji' section works correctly (switches whole app UI instantly, unaffected by country changes, and vice versa). FOUND ONE BUG: the onboarding quiz screen (quiz-steps.ts) has zero i18n/language parameterization - question text and answer option labels stay hardcoded in Polish regardless of ui_language, producing a mixed-language quiz (e.g. English chrome 'Question 1 of 10'/'Next' but Polish question 'Jakiej zmiany szukasz?' and options 'Szukam swojej drogi'/'Zmieniam branzke').

ui_bugs.issue: Quiz question text and answer option labels are hardcoded Polish strings in quiz-steps.ts with no language parameter at all (no t()/i18n usage), so a non-Polish ui_language user (e.g. English) sees a MIXED-LANGUAGE quiz: screen chrome ('Question 1 of 10', 'Next' button) correctly localizes to English, but every question/answer text (e.g. 'Jakiej zmiany szukasz?', 'Szukam swojej drogi', 'Zmieniam branzke') stays in Polish. This breaks the core promise of the feature ('ui_language controls literally everything else [besides job titles / country-native AI content]') for the onboarding quiz specifically.

action_items: Localize src/quiz-steps.ts (question titles, subtitles, option labels, placeholders) into the 4 supported languages, keyed off ui_language, same as the rest of the app's i18n/*.ts dictionaries, so the onboarding quiz is never mixed-language.

Double check other screens that might read raw hardcoded Polish strings outside the i18n/*.ts files (quiz-steps.ts was the only one found so far, but a repo-wide grep for Polish diacritics outside i18n/ and server.py prompts would be prudent before calling the feature complete).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py language/country split implementation is clean: SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES, LANGUAGE_NAMES, country_native_lang(), effective_language(), system_message(country, language) and career_cache_key(title, country, language) are all correctly threaded through every AI-generation call site (recommendations, career detail, roadmap, study/daily plans). PATCH /account/language correctly validates against SUPPORTED_LANGUAGES (400 on invalid) and never touches country; PATCH /account/country never touches ui_language. Register correctly defaults ui_language to the country's native language only when not explicitly supplied.

Frontend auth.tsx's lang computed value (user.ui_language || localLanguage || countryToLang(localCountry)) is a sensible fallback chain and localStorage persistence (LOCAL_LANGUAGE_KEY) correctly survives navigation from country-select -> auth -> register within the same session.

Profile.tsx correctly separates the 'Kraj i rynek pracy' and 'Jezyk aplikacji' sections into independent state/handlers (selectCountry vs selectLanguage), each calling its own PATCH endpoint - verified via UI that toggling one never flips the other's selected radio.

Gap: quiz-steps.ts was apparently not touched by this feature's implementation at all - it predates ui_language and was never wired up, so it silently falls back to always-Polish regardless of the new independent language setting.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (country-select language picker, profile language/country independence, admin regression all pass; quiz content localization fails)

seed_data_creation: Created several throwaway TESTLANG_*/TEST_e2e*/test_e2e2_* users via registration for backend+frontend tests (not cleaned up, harmless). Temporarily changed ania_t1@test.pl's country to DE and ui_language to en during manual profile-screen testing - REVERTED back to country=PL, ui_language=pl afterward via PATCH /account/country and /account/language (confirmed via final API response).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend feature (the hard, critical part) is solid - 8/8 tests pass covering register defaults, PATCH /account/language (valid+invalid), PATCH /account/country independence, DE/EN and NL/PL cross-language recommendation+career-detail generation, and PL regression. Frontend country-select screen and Profile screen's new language section both work correctly and independently of country. The ONE real bug is quiz-steps.ts being entirely unlocalized (hardcoded Polish) - this needs a proper fix (add per-language question/option dictionaries or route through i18n) before the feature can be called fully complete on the frontend side. Retest quiz screen in all 4 languages once fixed.
rca_of_issue: quiz-steps.ts defines the 10-question onboarding survey as a flat array of plain-string Polish labels/placeholders with no indirection through the i18n system (confirmed via grep: no t./Lang/i18n references in the file, only raw Polish text like 'Jakiej zmiany szukasz?'). The rest of the app (profile.tsx, country-select.tsx, auth screens) was updated to read strings via t.<namespace>.<key> from src/i18n/{pl,en,de,nl}.ts, but quiz.tsx/quiz-steps.ts appears to predate or was out of scope for this change, so it never got equivalent per-language dictionaries. Fix: either (a) move all quiz question/option/placeholder text into the 4 i18n files under a new 'quiz' namespace and have quiz.tsx read from t.quiz.*, or (b) make quiz-steps.ts a function quizSteps(lang) returning the right array per language.
